caption:
Global Metadata:
Basic Attributes: bpm is 100, warm major tonality. Savanna Toybox Instrumental / Gentle World-Folk, drawing on the roots-traditional-global style family (kalimba, marimba, soft hand drum) with a warm, simple pop sense of melody.
Global Emotional Progression: The piece opens with a single warm kalimba phrase, like dawn breaking over open grassland. It settles quickly into a light, contented, consistently warm energy that carries evenly through the instrumental sections without ever swelling into a big dramatic peak or dropping into a quiet dip, then eases down gently in the outro to a soft close, like the sun settling behind the horizon.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: A tactile felt-and-cardstock papercraft savanna diorama on a sunlit tabletop; a small child's finger tracing a paper map across golden grassland and a winding paper river; a gentle world tour full of friendly animals and cozy discovery, never adventure-movie tension.
Sonics & Production Profile: Warm, close, mostly acoustic mix with natural, light compression. Moderate stereo width, soft rounded low end, present but gentle mids, no harsh or piercing highs. Consistent, even loudness throughout with no sudden dynamic jumps, so the track can sit quietly under a child's voice and sound effects without ever startling.

Vocal Details:
Fully instrumental. No vocals, no singing, no vocalizing, no spoken words anywhere in the track. The lead melodic role is carried by kalimba, answered and doubled by marimba.

Arrangement:
Instrument Lifecycle (Primary/Secondary): Primary: a warm, plinking kalimba carries the main tune from the first bar to the last. Secondary: marimba enters in the intro to double and answer the kalimba melody in call-and-response; a soft hand-drum pulse and light shaker enter after the intro; an occasional soft breathy flute-like accent fills between phrases.
Groove & Foundation Progression: A gentle hand-drum keeps a steady, even, unhurried pulse from the first instrumental section onward, joined by a soft shaker. The groove stays consistently relaxed across all instrumental sections with no build-up, drop, or breakdown; the outro simply thins back down to solo kalimba.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: A soft wood-block or finger-cymbal sparkle marks the transition into each instrumental section. Light room ambience only, no reverb swells, no risers, no sweeps — nothing loud or sudden, safe and soothing for a preschool-aged listener on a tablet speaker.
